ModMetaData.name: Quick Stockpile Creation
ModMetaData.author: slofa
ModMetaData.description: Quality of Life mod that allows you to quickly create a stockpile, shelf, or bookcase directly from an item, for just that item type, with a few other features. This works fine with modded items and item categories, and is safe to add to - and be removed from - existing games. Features • Selecting any haulable item gives a new command to create a new stockpile or shelves just for that item type • Right-clicking on that command lets you create stockpiles or shelves for any of the item's categories • Select multiple items at once and create a stockpile or shelves for all those items • Stockpiles created with this mod use intelligent names • Selecting an item already in a stockpile gives a command to let you disallow it in that stockpile • Right-click on that command to disallow the item's categories instead • You can undo any disallows in case you make a mistake Credits • Russian translation by Reiquard (https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198012474522) • Simplified Chinese translation by HawnHan (https://steamcommunity.com/id/HawnHan) • Spanish translation by Crusader (https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561197986639775)
